title: My Last Video (April Fools)
summary: April Fools video. He opens pretending the channel is ending after four months ('My Last Video'), then reveals the hoax and plays three games of completely normal 3+0 blitz on his main ~2100 account vs ~2100 humans: game 1 (Black, Caro-Kann) won in a K+P endgame, game 2 (White, London) lost in time trouble, game 3 (White) won with a queen mate. Final 2-1.
rules: Normal chess, 3+0 blitz, no special rules.

board.theme_notes: standard chess.com green board; thumbnail says 'Goodbye.'
